notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
Tonight's update includes all of the changes to the demo based on player feedback.

Tutorial is more spread out to avoid information overload.

The drone is no longer required to connect to terminals.

Added a new event, Void Larvae.

The drone is now used as part of this event.

Biomass now requires you to lower the temps in the adjacent ship sections.

Increased volume of ship voice when detecting an anomaly.

Some bug fixes.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600085/7e1497bc4b561cd4226a8528e217812634f8f8db.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45600085/c4c15a5caa088734966f66104d9507495d975eb0.png"]

Thank you again to everyone for your feedback. We look forward to hearing what you think of these updates!



-Jon and Callie

notes.title: Void Stalkers Demo Update
notes.content:
A big thank you to everyone who played the Void Stalkers Demo during Next Fest and offered us feedback! We're in the process of making some big changes to the demo based on that feedback.

Currently in development:

Reducing the reliance on the drone for most of the events. You will no longer need it to connect to ship terminals.

Instead, the drone will be part of the solution for specific events. More on this later!

Spreading out the tutorial a bit so the game isn't throwing so much at you all at once.

Lots of updates to the tutorial text to make it easier to understand what you need to do. 

Other small tweaks and upgrades based on feedback.

The demo will continue to be available while we work on these changes. Once they are live, we will post an announcement. We're looking forward to hearing you feedback on the changes!

Thank you again!

-Jon and Callie

Void Stalkers Discord: https://discord.gg/4m6Kmd2dMX

notes.title: Playtest Build 0.0.80 Update
notes.content:
We just released build 0.0.80 that has the following changes based on feedback from our playtesters.

Added text to Tutorial Screens to let players know then can right click to speed up the typing text
Added option to turn off typing text.
Added text to drone screen when a waypoint is invalid
Consolidated the two comms buttons (next and close) to be one button that does both
The drone now has a power indicator on its back. Power is used when it's not at home. If power drains it immediately goes back to home location and recharges. This will disconnect any terminals you are connected to
Added icon to terminal screen that reinforces which terminal you are connected to
Added y/n to quit and reset save in the title screen
Added some dialog about why you have 3 cargos now
Fixed cargo letters
Fixed alignment start location during tutorial
Added some additional tutorial text when you open the dials terminal the first time and not for the biomass event
Added "check your cargo!" tutorial text at the start of jump 1 as a reminder

Thank you to everyone who has played the playtest! If you have any additional feedback please post here or in the Discord!

Jon & Callie, SuperSixStudios
Void Stalkers Discord: https://discord.gg/4m6Kmd2dMX
